description:
Crop an image

Extract a rectangular region from an image, in one of three mutually exclusive modes. Manual: give the top-left corner (x, y) and dimensions (width, height) in pixels. Smart crop: give 'gravity' (attention, entropy, centre) plus width and height; the window is picked automatically, clamped to the source if the target is larger. Trim: set 'trim: true' (optional 'threshold') to remove a uniform background border via content detection; the applied rect is reported in X-Pictomancer-Trim-* headers. Optional enhancement modifiers: denoise (1-3), equalize, sharpen (applied denoise -> equalize -> op -> sharpen).

### Responses:

**200**: Processed image binary (Success Response)
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Type: image/jpeg

**Example Response:**
```json
"string"
```
Content-Type: image/png

**Example Response:**
```json
"string"
```
Content-Type: image/webp

**Example Response:**
```json
"string"
```

autorot.description: Apply EXIF orientation before cropping. Opt-in; default false, which preserves current byte-for-byte behavior.
autorot.title: autorot

headers.description: Optional storage headers to include on the PUT call (Content-Type, Cache-Control, x-amz-acl, etc.). Whitelisted at SSRF layer.
headers.title: Headers

put_url.description: Customer-signed presigned PUT URL where the optimized bytes will be written. Must be https://. Cloud credentials never reach our infrastructure; only the URL itself is used and discarded after the request.
put_url.title: Put Url

callback_url.description: Customer endpoint where the optimized bytes will be POSTed. Must be https://. For async/large jobs. We send an X-Pig-Sha256 header of the body so the receiver can verify integrity. No credentials are stored on our side; secure the endpoint with a token in the URL itself.
callback_url.title: Callback Url

headers.description: Optional headers to include on the POST call (Content-Type, Cache-Control, x-amz-*, etc.). Whitelisted at SSRF layer.
headers.title: Headers

secret.description: Optional HMAC secret. When set, we sign the POST body with HMAC-SHA256 and send 'X-Pig-Signature: sha256=<hex>'. Used per request and never stored. Recompute the HMAC on your endpoint to authenticate the callback (constant-time compare).
secret.title: Secret

denoise.description: Median denoise before cropping: radius 1-3 (window 3x3 to 7x7). Opt-in; no surcharge.
denoise.title: denoise

equalize.description: Auto-contrast (histogram equalisation of the value channel; hue and saturation preserved) before cropping. Opt-in.
equalize.title: equalize

format.description: Output format: jpeg, png, webp, tiff, gif, or avif. If omitted, the original format is preserved.
format.title: format

gravity.description: Smart-crop mode: picks the window automatically. One of ('attention', 'entropy', 'centre'). Requires width and height; mutually exclusive with x/y and trim. A target larger than the source clamps to the source size.
gravity.title: gravity

height.description: Height of the crop rectangle in pixels. Required in manual and gravity modes.
height.title: height

sharpen.description: Unsharp-mask sharpen after cropping (libvips defaults). Opt-in.
sharpen.title: sharpen

source.description: Image source: a public URL (https://...) or a base64-encoded string (optionally as a data URI like data:image/png;base64,...).
source.title: source

threshold.description: Trim sensitivity (must be positive; default 10.0). Only valid together with trim: true.
threshold.title: threshold

trim.description: Trim mode: removes a uniform background border via content detection. Mutually exclusive with x/y/width/height/gravity.
trim.title: trim

width.description: Width of the crop rectangle in pixels. Required in manual and gravity modes.
width.title: width

x.description: Left edge of the crop rectangle in pixels. Manual mode only.
x.title: x

y.description: Top edge of the crop rectangle in pixels. Manual mode only.
y.title: y

name: crop_image
